description: A tall, open-back bookshelf with four turquoise rectangular compartments supported by two light brown wooden vertical beams on each side. The compartments are stacked vertically, with the top one slightly recessed. The overall design is minimalist and modern, with clean lines and a simple structure. The open back allows for light to pass through, giving it an airy feel. This bookshelf is ideal for displaying books, decorative items, or plants.
